acceptanceCriteria.text: Empty username -> "Epic sadface: Username is required"
Wrong details -> "Username and password do not match any user in this service"

gaps.text: AC-1 gives its message with the prefix "Epic sadface: "; AC-2 and AC-3 give theirs without it. The exact expected text of AC-2 and AC-3 is therefore unknown.
"Wrong details" does not say whether it means a wrong username, a wrong password, or both, nor whether all three give the same message.
Both fields empty is not covered: which message is shown when the username AND the password are empty?
gaps.source: decision table of AC-1 x AC-2

gaps.text: Nothing says what happens to the form after an error: are the inputs kept or cleared, can the error be dismissed, are the fields highlighted?
Not stated whether a username of spaces only counts as empty (AC-1), and whether the password check is case sensitive (AC-3).
The stakeholders are placeholders (<PO name> / <BA name> / <Dev lead name>), so nobody is named who can answer the questions.

questions.question: What is the exact expected text for AC-2 (empty password) and AC-3 (wrong details): with the prefix "Epic sadface: " like AC-1, or without it as written?
questions.why: Expected results must be exact. Without the answer, AC-2 and AC-3 cannot pass or fail meaningfully. The same question applies to SD-03 (locked-out message), which shares the error area.
options: None carries it (AC-1 is a typo)

questions.question: Does AC-3 "Wrong details" cover a wrong username with a valid password, a valid username with a wrong password, and both wrong? Is the message the same for all three?
questions.why: Decides how many AC-3 cases exist and their expected results. A different message per case would reveal which usernames exist (a security concern).

questions.question: When both username and password are empty, which message is expected: the username message (AC-1), the password message (AC-2), or both?
questions.why: A common case with no defined result; without it the case is Blocked.

questions.question: After a login error, should the typed inputs be kept or cleared, should the error be dismissible (e.g. an X button), and should the fields be highlighted?
questions.why: Defines the after-error state; currently untestable.

questions.question: Does a username made only of spaces count as empty (AC-1 message)? Is the password comparison case sensitive ("Secret_Sauce" -> AC-3 message)?
questions.why: Boundary cases; the expected results are not stated.

questions.question: Who are the PO, BA and Dev lead for EPIC 1, so the questions can be answered and recorded with a name?
questions.why: The readiness gate needs answers from a named person; the story lists placeholders only.
